log.text: Floette used Light of Ruin → Aerodactyl
Floette used Light of Ruin → Aerodactyl

decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: Gengar. Turn-one job: Aerodactyl sets Tailwind through Focus Sash to outspeed Scarf Dragapult, while Mega Gengar traps Floette/Arcanine with Shadow Tag and threatens KOes with Sludge Bomb/Shadow Ball. Backline: Empoleon punishes Hisuian Arcanine's Intimidate via Competitive while resisting Fairy/Water attacks, and Multiscale Dragonite acts as a clean-up threat under Tailwind with priority Extreme Speed.
decisions.notebook: Opponent roster: Scarf Dragapult, Floette-Eternal (Floettite), Defiant Annihilape, Life Orb Hisuian Arcanine, Wide Lens Maushold, Adaptability Basculegion.

decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: Floette. Lead Floette+Maushold: T1 Follow Me + Light of Ruin/Moonblast pressure under Friend Guard into DN/Gengar/Clef. Back Dragapult+Basculegion complete Ghost STAB into Gengar/Clef, Scarf speed, Last Respects snowball, Water into Aero/Fire-Rock.
decisions.notebook: Matchup build: Opp Mega Gengar+DN core, Intimidate, Empoleon need Fairy Aura, Ghost/Fighting, redirect. Mega Floette+Maushold FG/FM offensive pivot; Dragapult+Basc Ghost STAB into Gengar/Clef (Basc covers Fire/Rock); Annihilape RF+H-Arcanine Intim+ES break Multiscale/Unaware, priority into Steel/Fairy. Speed control/chip for LR/RF snowball. Registered sets unchanged.

decisions.rationale: Gengar resists all of Floette's potential attacks (Fairy/Grass) and is immune to Maushold's Population Bomb. Aerodactyl holds Focus Sash, guaranteeing Tailwind setup regardless of opponent targets. Mega Evolving Gengar activates Shadow Tag to trap the lead pair while setting Tailwind to gain full speed control over their Scarf Dragapult and remaining roster. Sludge Bomb targets Floette for massive 2x super-effective damage or chunking Maushold if redirected by Follow Me.
decisions.notebook: Opponent team: Scarf Dragapult, Floette-Eternal (Floettite), Defiant Annihilape, Life Orb Hisuian Arcanine, Wide Lens Maushold, Adaptability Basculegion.

selection: Light of Ruin -> foe 2 (Aerodactyl) + Mega Evolve
decisions.rationale: Mega into Aero with LoR while Maus Follow Me protects from Gengar Sludge/WoW and lets Friend Guard cut spread. Sash Aero survives one hit; FM pivots next. Avoid Gengar (Fairy resists).
decisions.notebook: Matchup build: Opp Mega Gengar+DN core, Intimidate, Empoleon need Fairy Aura, Ghost/Fighting, redirect. Mega Floette+Maushold FG/FM offensive pivot; Dragapult+Basc Ghost STAB into Gengar/Clef (Basc covers Fire/Rock). Speed control/chip for LR snowball. Registered sets unchanged. Opp Aero sash Pressure Jolly Tailwind/RS/WG/Taunt; Gengar Timid CursedBody mega ShadowTag.

decisions.rationale: Gengar-Mega's Shadow Tag prevents Maushold and Floette-Mega from switching. Sludge Bomb guarantees a KO on Floette-Mega from 49% HP. Aerodactyl's spread Rock Slide bypasses Follow Me to KO Maushold (at 7% HP). If Maushold uses Protect, Sludge Bomb removes Floette-Mega immediately. If Maushold uses Follow Me, Rock Slide KOs Maushold, and if Aerodactyl acts before Gengar in the speed tie, Sludge Bomb still hits Floette-Mega for a double KO.

Gengar outspeeds and OHKOes Floette with Sludge; Aero RS KOes both under Tailwind. Double Protect survives the turn, burns Tailwind, and keeps Fairy Aura for next. Attacking loses Floette for free; FM still dies to RS.
decisions.notebook: Matchup build: Opp Mega Gengar+DN core, Intimidate, Empoleon need Fairy Aura, Ghost/Fighting, redirect. Mega Floette+Maushold FG/FM offensive pivot; Dragapult+Basc Ghost STAB into Gengar/Clef (Basc covers Fire/Rock). Speed control/chip for LR snowball. Registered sets unchanged. Opp Aero sash Pressure Jolly Tailwind/RS/WG/Taunt; Gengar Timid mega ShadowBall/Sludge/WoW/Protect. Gengar CursedBody likely.

decisions.rationale: Under Tailwind, both our active Pokémon move before the foes. Rock Slide hits both targets, KOing Maushold (7% HP) and chipping Floette-Mega. If Maushold uses Follow Me, Sludge Bomb is redirected to KO Maushold while Rock Slide hits Floette. If Maushold does not Follow Me, Sludge Bomb easily KOs Floette-Mega (49% HP) while Rock Slide KOs Maushold. Gengar-Mega comfortably survives any single attack from Floette-Mega.

Gengar outspeeds the entire opposing roster under Tailwind (400 Speed vs Scarf Dragapult's max 319). Dragonite comes in cleanly with Multiscale intact, giving immediate ExtremeSpeed priority to secure the KO on 1% Floette-Mega regardless of priority or potential tailwind interaction.

Aero 1% dies to any hit; LoR guarantees KO through WG fail risk. FM redirects Gengar sludge off 49% Floette. Both Protects half-fail after prior use. Maus 8% dies to almost anything else; FM preserves FG pivot and forces Gengar retarget.
Floette 1% dies to any Gengar hit under TW; Scarf Pult outspeeds TW Gengar and 2x SB pressures it or U-turns; Basc slower and weaker into Gengar/Poison. Bring Pult now for immediate revenge/speed.
decisions.notebook: Matchup build: Opp Mega Gengar+DN core, Intimidate, Empoleon need Fairy Aura, Ghost/Fighting, redirect. Mega Floette+Maushold FG/FM offensive pivot; Dragapult+Basc Ghost STAB into Gengar/Clef (Basc covers Fire/Rock). Speed control/chip for LR snowball. Registered sets unchanged. Opp Aero sash Pressure Jolly Tailwind/RS/WG/Taunt; Gengar Timid mega ShadowBall/Sludge/WoW/Protect. Gengar CursedBody likely. Aero gone; TW 2t left.

decisions.rationale: Gengar outspeeds Choice Scarf Dragapult under Tailwind (400 vs max 319) and strikes first with super-effective Shadow Ball. Dragonite uses +2 priority Extreme Speed into 1 HP Floette-Mega to secure the KO before either opposing Pokémon can act (unless Floette Protects). Even if Dragapult survives Gengar's attack, Dragonite's Multiscale easily absorbs any incoming attack.
decisions.notebook: Opponent team: Scarf Dragapult (Timid max 213, 319 with Scarf), Floette-Eternal (Floettite), Defiant Annihilape, Life Orb Hisuian Arcanine, Wide Lens Maushold, Adaptability Basculegion.

decisions.rationale: Floette 1% dies to any contact; Protect wastes ES/Sludge. Scarf Pult outspeeds DN under TW; Shadow Ball 2x into frail Gengar forces KO/chip before TW ends. ES immune on Pult. Multiscale DN survives one Draco.
decisions.notebook: Matchup build: Opp Mega Gengar+DN core, Intimidate Krook, Empoleon need Fairy Aura, Ghost/Fighting, redirect. Mega Floette+Maushold FG/FM offensive pivot; Dragapult+Basc Ghost STAB into Gengar/Clef (Basc covers Fire/Rock, LR after faints). Speed control/chip for LR snowball. Registered sets unchanged. Opp Aero sash Pressure Jolly TW/RS/WG/Taunt (gone). Gengar Timid mega SB/Sludge/WoW/Protect; CursedBody likely. DN Adamant Multiscale Lum ES/Outrage/EQ/DD. Krook Scarf Jolly. Emp Modest Sitrus Competitive. Clef Bold Unaware FM/MB/HH/Protect. Priority: remove Gengar then Multiscale chip; Basc LR snowball late.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Dragonite's priority +2 Extreme Speed guarantees the finish on 1% Floette-Mega before it can attack or react. Gengar-Mega (Speed 200) outspeeds Basculegion (max 130) and lands a heavy 2x super-effective Shadow Ball, either KOing Basculegion directly or leaving it in trivial range for our remaining healthy team.
decisions.notebook: Opponent team: Scarf Dragapult, Floette-Eternal (Floettite), Defiant Annihilape, Life Orb Hisuian Arcanine, Wide Lens Maushold, Adaptability Basculegion.

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Floette 1% dies to any hit; Protect (even reduced) is only way to keep Fairy Aura and force Gengar/DN to reveal. Basc LR (150BP Adapt) into Gengar is 2x Ghost and likely OHKOs through no Multiscale. If Protect fails we lose Floette but still pressure Gengar. LR DN wastes Multiscale chip for later.

Mega Floette+Maushold FG/FM offensive pivot; Dragapult+Basc Ghost STAB into Gengar/Clef (Basc covers Fire/Rock, LR after faints). Speed control/chip for LR snowball. Registered sets unchanged. Opp Aero sash Pressure Jolly TW/RS/WG/Taunt (gone). Gengar Timid mega SB/Sludge/WoW/Protect; CursedBody likely. DN Adamant Multiscale Lum ES/Outrage/EQ/DD. Krook Scarf Jolly. Emp Modest Sitrus Competitive. Clef Bold Unaware FM/MB/HH/Protect. Priority: remove Gengar then Multiscale chip; Basc LR snowball late. Two allies fainted → LR 150BP.

reflections.summary: Mega Gengar and Aerodactyl speed control trapped and removed opponent's redirection before Scarf Dragapult and Basculegion could stabilize, allowing fast STAB attacks and Dragonite's Extreme Speed to sweep.
reflections.adjustment: Anticipate defensive double-Protects on turns where opponent seeks to stall Tailwind, using those turns to set up Dragonite or refine positioning instead of double-attacking into Protects.
reflections.notebook: Opponent specifics: Mega Floette (Light of Ruin, Fairy Aura), Maushold (Wide Lens, Follow Me), Dragapult (Choice Scarf), Basculegion (Adaptability). Strategy: Opponent relies on Maushold redirection to preserve Floette. Mega Gengar + Aerodactyl lead reliably denies their game plan, but prepare for benched H-Arcanine Intimidate or Annihilape anti-speed control adjustments in Game 2.

reflections.summary: Lost because Mega Floette+Maushold lead was mismatched into Gengar+Aero Tailwind: Sludge Bombs deleted the Friend Guard redirector while LoR recoil + Rock Slide left Floette at 1% and unable to survive subsequent Dragonite Extreme Speed after Dragapult also fell to Shadow Ball.
reflections.adjustment: Change team-preview: do not bring/lead Mega Floette into the Gengar+Aero core; select a different four that pressures Gengar earlier (Dragapult/Basculegion Ghost STAB) and chips Multiscale without exposing the frail Fairy Aura mega so soon.
reflections.notebook: Opp Mega Gengar+DN core, Intimidate Krook, Empoleon, Clef Unaware. Gengar Timid mega SB/Sludge/WoW/Protect (aggressively Sludges redirectors). Aero sash Pressure Jolly TW/RS/WG/Taunt. DN Adamant Multiscale Lum ES/Outrage/EQ/DD. Krook Scarf Jolly. Emp Modest Sitrus Competitive. Clef Bold Unaware FM/MB/HH/Protect. Floette mega+Maushold FG/FM lead fails vs Gengar+Aero TW (recoil+chip unsustainable, ES cleans). Need Ghost/Fighting + redirect but delay Fairy Aura mega; remove Gengar first then Multiscale chip for Basc LR snowball. Registered sets unchanged.
